name: Fuyuno Kaoru
source:
A 21-year-old university student.
The perpetrator of the murder that occurred in Yade Town.
She was arrested by the police once, but escaped.
Her whereabouts are currently unknown.

[From the [url=http://www.wabin-project.com/works/reversible/character.html]official website[/url]]
